saints.name: Francis de Sales
saints.legacy: Champion of gentleness and spiritual guidance
saints.summary: Saint Francis de Sales was a 17th-century bishop known for his gentle approach to spirituality and his efforts to convert Calvinists in the Chablais region. He co-founded the Order of the Visitation with Saint Jane Frances de Chantal and emphasized the importance of meekness and humility. His writings, particularly 'Introduction to the Devout Life,' have had a lasting impact on Catholic spirituality.
